title: Remove optional account extensions from required repository paths
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Remove optional account extensions from required repository paths
events.body:
## Outcome

Keep cloning, mirroring, contributing, identity, and self-hosting independent of optional account-service modules.

## Implementation

- Move optional account extensions behind explicit versioned interfaces and disabled-by-default feature flags.
- Remove optional-service fields and calls from required repository creation, node startup, identity, clone, push, and contribution paths.
- Namespace optional schemas, routes, migrations, and UI so the core can build and run with the module absent.
- Provide a reversible migration for existing optional records without changing repository identities or signed collaboration history.
- Generate core documentation and API schemas from a build in which optional modules are not present.

## Acceptance criteria

- Core desktop, browser, headless, relay, and self-host tests pass with the optional module physically absent.
- No required API response or signed repository object contains an optional-module field.
- Enabling or disabling the module does not change Git or collaboration object identifiers.
- Migration is idempotent and preserves user-controlled exports.
- Core onboarding contains no optional-service detour.

## Dependencies

None.

## Verification

Build and run the complete core portfolio with the module absent, disabled, enabled, migrated, and removed again; compare repository identities, signed event bytes, API schemas, and onboarding steps.
